title: Replication package - The certification ladder: what researcher-ranking levels measure, and what they miss
description: Rung-by-rung audit of Peru's RENACYT researcher-ranking levels against the open bibliographic record: 10,455 certified researchers linked to their OpenAlex production (2015-2026), per-level medians, adjacent-rung AUCs, seniority-controlled partials, per-field associations, gender composition by rank, and a recent-entrant cohort analysis. Companion to a manuscript submitted to Research Evaluation.
